data.text:
There is a flood of similar comments on Tiktok claiming only international media (specifically myself) covered the EDSA anti-corruption rally yesterday, and that either there is a news blackout or local press have been paid not to report on protests. 

This is NOT TRUE.

There were many reporters and photojournalists of national media outlets at yesterday’s demonstration and at every other one prior.

And beyond protests and Congressional hearings, they’ve doing excellent investigative work.

I don’t know if it’s propaganda and/or coordinated online disinformation. But if it is, don’t be swayed. A simple search on Google will show extensive coverage by Philippine press on this issue.
